title: FOGA on its own: the released package runs with every Finchain endpoint refused
source: manifests/evidence/foga-isolation-1.0.7-20261112T151124Z.json, written by scripts/foga-isolation-check.sh (make foga-isolation VERSION=1.0.7) on an AWS EC2 host of the project (Amazon Linux, Node v22.22.0, npm 10.9.4, anvil 1.7.1-dev from the FOGA Foundry directory); an earlier run the same day without the Sepolia leg (foga-isolation-1.0.7-20261112T144653Z.json, not committed) gave the same result
boundary: docs/world.md section 3, docs/acceptance.md M3-B: FOGA is a separate product; nothing in it reaches for Finchain unless a world file names a Finchain address. This record is the baseline for every later FOGA candidate.

package.name: @finchip.ai/foga
package.installedFrom: the npm registry into a clean directory with a clean HOME (nothing of the operator's FOGA configuration, keys or store)
package.finchainCode: none: the chain table has no Finchain entry and the default chain is sepolia with a packaged world

method.hook: scripts/foga-isolation-preload.mjs preloaded into every Node process of the package (NODE_OPTIONS=--import): every host name resolved (dns.lookup, dns.promises.lookup) or connected to (net.Socket.prototype.connect) is logged; any name under finchain.one fails as ENOTFOUND at the resolver and at the socket
method.controls: pass: a real name (registry.npmjs.org) is logged, a socket to an IP literal (127.0.0.1) is logged, rpc.finchain.one is refused at the resolver and at the socket
method.installerExcluded: the installer's own lookups are cleared from the log before the legs run

legs.what: the package's chain table: no Finchain entry; sepolia carries a packaged world (the default of a bare foga join)
foga quickstart --exit: a local world and a live cell on anvil, no public chain
foga demo --genesis T9 --port 8599: the local genesis T0-T9 on anvil

foga doctor --world deployments/sepolia.example.json --rpc <SEPOLIA_RPC_URL>: the packaged Sepolia World read through the operator's Sepolia provider; the doctor exits 3 on the Sepolia fixture's known failing layer (the upstream ARD fixture registry's older source), and the leg is the read: a report was written

hostNames.note: the Sepolia provider's host name is the operator's choice (SEPOLIA_RPC_URL); the URL itself is redacted from the evidence

result: PASS: every leg passing, zero names under finchain.one
storeResume: an old cell store continued by the package under test is covered by FOGA's own test suite and release check, not by this script (docs/acceptance.md M3-B, third item): recorded there, not here
openItems: repeat this check, same command, for every later FOGA candidate before it is published; the record of each goes beside this one
